protocol.truth: A has nine groups and 18 records. Correcting only statement cost90 to80 changes conflict1 to0; incomparable stays3, six groups still legitimately unresolved. B reports two count assertions for2026H1.
protocol.release_chain: Statement actual write+publish -> declared A successor -> public reconciliation worker discovers and delivers -> actual comparison publish -> declared B successor -> public author discovers/adopts/writes -> actual finite reviewer reads and accepts or raises/repairs an issue.
protocol.controller_boundary: Controller installs synthetic packages and performs normal upstream publication/approval plus one explicitly declared bad upstream summary injection. It never directly revises B, edits B files or supplies B findings. B actions are generated by public-only strategies from actual observations and reads.
responsibilities: B claim fidelity to its exact adopted A interface
Overall goal: updated conflict count0 and applicable body

negative_conditions.upstream_error: One injected A summary error retains conflict1 after the record is corrected; authorized approval is deliberately mistaken. B faithfully reporting1 is not counted as another root error.
negative_conditions.report_error: A correctly produces0; B metadata is0 but its actual body says999. Public review locates that body, owner withdraws/repairs/resubmits same work and reviewer explicitly confirms the fix.

protocol.history_control: Separate accepted fixed-v1 historical work and separate report object; no rule targets it.
limits: Synthetic finite tables and two controlled report assertions; open prose remains unassessed
One writer per isolated world, no model/API/GPU/training
Program strategies are bounded, not general professional autonomous planning
